# DropSpace v0.3.1-beta.4

<!-- update-summary: 修复查找现成译文超时后 AI 翻译不启动的问题；译文补充查找上限调整为 3 秒；移除 AI 歌词 Beta 标记，改善歌词候选失败恢复和默认来源配置。 -->

## Fixes and improvements

- Restore optional, user-enabled AI translation when existing-translation lookup times out or fails after a valid original has been found. Existing translations and same-language lyrics still bypass AI; disabled AI remains disabled.
- Extend the shared supplemental lookup budget from 1.5 to 3 seconds, measured from the first valid original. Provider or candidate changes do not restart the clock. Original lyrics survive timeout; this does not extend the whole-song AI processing ceiling.
- Remove Beta display labels from AI lyrics settings and both model choices in Chinese and English. Model IDs, downloaded weights, cache compatibility and explicit opt-in remain unchanged.

- Recover from an individual candidate transport/parse failure without abandoning other allowed, identity-matched candidates; upstream authorization/rate-limit failures remain failures.
- Fresh installations enable online lyrics with NetEase first, no backup and remaining-provider search enabled. Existing explicit preferences are preserved.

## Verification and limitations

Focused managed regression checks cover bounded lookup, fallback admission and translations arriving after the previous deadline. Windows application and package checks are required for this release. UI labeling is a product designation, not a new claim of model semantic evaluation. Existing documented native-model and GPU measurement limitations remain; no new native-model quality pass is claimed.

## Compatibility

Semantic version: 0.3.1-beta.4. PE/MSIX version: 0.3.1.4. v0.3.1-beta.3 is the immediate upgrade baseline. Previous releases remain immutable. Stable remains v0.2.1. Existing installed models are reused; no model re-download is required.

## 中文说明

修复 beta3 中已有原歌词、但查找现成译文超时或失败后，连带跳过 AI 翻译的问题。查译文的额外等待上限改为 3 秒，超时保留原歌词，并按用户开启的 AI 设置继续翻译。中文歌不翻中文、已有目标语言译文不重复翻译的规则保留。
AI 歌词功能及模型选项不再显示 Beta 标记；模型文件、模型选择和开关设置保持兼容。

新安装默认启用在线歌词，首选网易云、不设备用源、开启其余来源搜索。已保存的用户设置不被覆盖。单个歌词候选获取失败后继续尝试同一允许来源内的其他有效候选；接口拒绝或不可用不会被误报为确定无歌词。
